formal: if len(recent) > limit then return False, 0
if not (len(recent) > limit) then return True, limit - len(recent)
limit_api(timestamps, now) returns (bool, int) where bool indicates if request is allowed
limit_api(timestamps, now) returns (status, remaining) where remaining >= 0
if len(recent) increases then remaining decreases or stays same
if len(recent) == 0 then remaining == limit, if len(recent) >= limit then status == False
limit_api(timestamps, now) == limit_api(timestamps, now) for same inputs
same inputs always produce same outputs
